description: Editable image contract for the PMG Used Car Sales theme. Every operator-editable theme image is a slot here; the dashboard Page Images tab renders one upload/replace control per slot, uploads persist to brand.images[<key>], and BrandStyles emits each as a --brand-image-<key> CSS var (camelCase to match the theme CSS). brand.images[<key>] overrides the theme default photo.

slots.label: Home hero
slots.aiHint: wide forecourt with a row of stock cars, jet/dark tone
slots.unsplashHint: used car dealership forecourt row of cars

slots.label: About page hero
slots.aiHint: the forecourt, premises or a signature vehicle

slots.label: Services band photo (Home)
slots.aiHint: wide banner of prepared vehicles / service line-up
slots.unsplashHint: row of used cars showroom banner

slots.label: Finance promo image (Home)
slots.aiHint: showroom desk, signing or a lead vehicle

slots.label: Part-exchange promo image (Home)
slots.aiHint: two cars side-by-side or keys being handed over

slots.label: Sell Your Car hero
slots.aiHint: owner next to their car or a car-keys close-up

slots.label: Car Sourcing hero
slots.aiHint: forecourt / vehicle procurement, dark cinematic tone
